rows.traditional: 對 A 嘅無動於衷
rows.jyutping: deoi3 A ge3 mou4 dung6 jyu1 cung1
rows.note: Use this for stoicism as emotional indifference or being unmoved by pain or pleasure.

example.english: Their stoicism showed in how unmoved they were by the criticism.
example.traditional: 佢對人哋點樣批評自己都無動於衷。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 dei6 dim2 joeng2 pai1 ping4 zi6 gei2 dou1 mou4 dung6 jyu1 zung1

rows.note: Use this when stoicism means the ability to endure pain or hardship rather than showing emotional indifference.

example.english: After the operation, they showed great stoicism and never cried out in pain.
example.traditional: 做完手術之後，佢仲係好有忍耐力，痛都冇叫過一聲。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 keoi5 zung6 hai6 hou2 jau5 jan2 noi6 lik6 tung3 dou1 mou5 giu3 gwo3 jat1 sing1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the ancient philosophical school and its doctrines.

example.english: The philosophy of stoicism says people should use reason to control their emotions.
example.traditional: 斯多葛主義認為人應該用理性控制情緒。
example.jyutping: si1 do1 got3 zyu2 ji6 jing6 wai4 jan4 jing1 goi1 jung6 lei5 sing3 hung3 zai3 cing4 seoi5
